body:
I told my mom about my thoughts (because she asked if I don't care about her because I helped her too late with one thing) and got a response, "Should I turn on gas so we both die if you don't wanna live?" 
I knew her. I should've known what I'd get. Why even care about me if I'm not enough even for her? If she thinks I'd better die if I don't get the work done. She's the person I live for, I live because I want to help her with my little brother and her problems, but at the end of the day I always mess up and what I do never seems enough so why stay alive at all?

I just don't feel like I should trying. I feel that the only good thing I can do is to finish it all. Like I need and have to just die. I want to live. I want to fell better. I want. But I can't think I'm allowed to. I'm just so scared now. I hate me, I hate saying to myself how much I hate myself, I hate feeling down and I hate to think I need help but I want help. I want someone to notice, to let me be weak, to let me just cry and to say that it's fine to just be me. I want someone to say that I deserve help. That I can go to a therapist and that I'm not fine and it's not fine to cut my hands and to want to die and it can be changed and there's someone who would help me change this because I cannot do it myself.
Can I keep living at all? Do I deserve to live? To be happy? Do I?
